nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_21
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment:
Player depletes boss stamina -- bStaggerRequested = true (latched event true until consume)

If stagger cooldown is active -- nothing happens yet, request stays true

The moment cooldown ends -- Director fires Stagger immediately (interrupt), then consumes request

While staggered:

    no stamina drain

    no new stagger requests

    pressure decays

On Stagger completion -- state exits to Combat and unlocks
